(cli-aliases)=

### `aliases`

Browse, add, and remove URL aliases (redirects) of items.

Subcommands: `add`, `list`, `remove`.

(cli-aliases-add)=

### `aliases add`

Make old paths redirect to an item.

| Argument or option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | str | yes | — | Item the aliases point to. |
| `aliases` | str | yes | — | Old paths. |

(cli-aliases-list)=

### `aliases list`

List the aliases of an item, or every redirect of the site.

| Argument or option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | str | no | `/` | Item; the site root lists every redirect. |
| `--query` | str | no | — | Filter, on the site root. |

(cli-aliases-remove)=

### `aliases remove`

Remove aliases.

| Argument or option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | str | yes | — | Item the aliases point to. |
| `aliases` | str | yes | — | Alias paths. |

(cli-create)=

### `create`

Create an item inside a folder.

| Argument or option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `parent` | str | yes | — | Path of the folder. |
| `portal_type` | str | yes | — | Content type, such as Document. |
| `--title` | str | no | — | Title. |

| `--description` | str | no | — | Description. |

(cli-create-page)=

### `create-page`

Create a page from Markdown or HTML, converted to blocks.

| Argument or option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `parent` | str | yes | — | Path of the folder. |
| `source` | str | yes | — | Markdown or HTML file; - reads standard input. |
| `--html` | flag | no | — | The source is HTML, not Markdown. |
| `--title` | str | no | — | Title; the leading # heading by default. |
| `--description` | str | no | — | Description. |
| `--type`, `-t` | str | no | `Document` | Content type, with blocks. |
| `--id` | str | no | — | Id (short name). |
| `--data`, `-d` | str | no | — | JSON object with field values; @file.json reads a file, - reads stdin. |
| `--set`, `-s` | str | no | — | Field value: key=text, or key:=json (subjects:='["a"]'). Repeatable. |
| `--file` | path | no | — | File or image to upload inside the page. |
| `--lead` | int range | no | — | Position of the lead image among the files, 1 for the first; the first image by default. |
| `--no-lead` | flag | no | — | Do not set a lead image. |
| `--publish` | str | no | — | Run this workflow transition at the end, e.g. publish. |
| `--blocks` | str | no | — | Block types to produce, as JSON, such as '{"codeBlock": {"style": "light"}, "slateTable": false}'; merged over the profile's. |

(cli-mcp)=

### `mcp`

Serve sites as an MCP server, over standard input and output or HTTP.

| Argument or option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--site` | str | no | — | Profile to serve; repeat it for several sites. |
| `--group` | str | no | — | Group of profiles to serve (see 'profile groups'). |
| `--all` | flag | no | — | Serve every profile. |
| `--tool` | str | no | — | Offer only this tool; repeat it for several. |
| `--http` | flag | no | — | Serve over streamable HTTP, with a bearer token. |
| `--host` | str | no | `127.0.0.1` | Address to listen on, with --http. |
| `--port` | int | no | `8000` | Port to listen on, with --http. |

(cli-mcp-token)=

### `mcp-token`

Manage the token MCP clients send to 'plone-client mcp --http'.

Subcommands: `delete`, `generate`, `set`.

(cli-mcp-token-delete)=

### `mcp-token delete`

Remove the token from the keyring.

### `mcp-token generate`

Make a new random token, store it in the keyring, and print it.

Store a token of your own in the keyring; it needs 32 characters.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--token-stdin` | flag | no | — | Read the token from standard input. |

(cli-profile)=

### `profile`

Manage connection profiles; secrets are kept in the system keyring.

Subcommands: `add`, `defaults`, `group-remove`, `group-set`, `groups`, `list`, `remove`, `set-secret`, `show`, `test`, `use`.

(cli-profile-add)=

### `profile add`

Add a profile, and store its secret in the keyring.

| Argument or option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | yes | — | Profile name. |
| `--url` | str | yes | — | URL of the site root. |
| `--username` | str | no | — | Login name; empty for anonymous. |
| `--auth` | str | no | `basic` | One of basic, jwt, token. |
| `--secret` | str | no | `keyring` | Where the secret is: keyring, env, command, none. |
| `--secret-env` | str | no | `PLONE_CLIENT_PASSWORD` | Variable holding the secret, with --secret env. |
| `--secret-command` | str | no | — | Command printing the secret, with --secret command. |
| `--read-only`, `--no-read-only` | flag | no | — | Refuse changes to this site. |
| `--timeout` | float | no | — | Seconds to wait for the site. |
| `--verify` | str | no | — | Verify TLS certificates: true, false, or a CA bundle path. |
| `--retries` | int | no | — | Times a request is repeated after a network error. |
| `--backoff` | float | no | — | Base delay in seconds between retries. |
| `--frontend-url` | str | no | — | URL of the Volto frontend, when --url is the backend; used to list the site's blocks. |
| `--blocks` | str | no | — | Block types that Markdown and HTML become on this site, as JSON, such as '{"codeBlock": true}'. |
| `--description` | str | no | — | Free text. |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | no | — | Read the secret from standard input. |
| `--use` | flag | no | — | Make it the current profile. |
| `--replace`, `--no-replace` | flag | no | — | Replace an existing profile. |

(cli-profile-defaults)=

### `profile defaults`

Show or change the connection settings shared by every profile.

| Argument or option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--timeout` | float | no | — | Seconds to wait for the site. |
| `--verify` | str | no | — | Verify TLS certificates: true, false, or a CA bundle path. |
| `--retries` | int | no | — | Times a request is repeated after a network error. |
| `--backoff` | float | no | — | Base delay in seconds between retries. |
| `--read-only`, `--read-write` | flag | no | — | Refuse changes to every site. |
| `--unset` | str | no | — | Remove a setting: timeout, verify, retries, backoff, api_prefix, read_only. |
